bullets.text: ResumeBoost (ML-Based Optimiser) [GitHub] Full-stack Python tool using Docker, deployed on Heroku around a custom spaCy NER model with a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and an active-learning loop refining user keyword suggestions.
Government Spending Analytics [GitHub] - Designed a complete BI Data Warehouse solution, including an SQL ETL pipeline and star-schema architecture to analyse procurement trends.
